title: Yearly Trips and Inspection Validity: Calculation Note for Wayfare Driver Agreements
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing.** How heavily a Wayfare driver's vehicle is used bears on the inspection validity days, the calendar days from the inspection date for which a passed vehicle inspection counts as the vehicle inspection on file.

## Yearly trips

The agreement's lifetime trips divided by its days active, counted from its activation date to the recording day, and multiplied by 365 give its yearly trips. Lifetime trips and the activation date are read from the agreement. A count of days active of zero is taken as one. The yearly trips are not rounded.

## Rule

Yearly trips of at least 1000 change the inspection validity days by -20 days, yearly trips of at least 500 but fewer than 1000 change them by -10 days, and fewer than 500 leave them unchanged.

| Yearly trips | Change to the inspection validity days |
|---|---|
| 1000 or more | -20 |
| 500 or more, below 1000 | -10 |
| below 500 | 0 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical agreements)

| Lifetime trips | Days active | Yearly trips | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3000 | 1095 | 1000.0 | -20 |
| 2400 | 1000 | 876.0 | -10 |
| 1369 | 1000 | 499.685 | 0 |

The third row stays below 500 because the yearly trips are compared unrounded.
